headline: Across a 5-model 2023→2025 chat ladder scored by the same paper-exact judge, persona-vector steering (traits pushed to 72–100/100) and sample-separability (AUC ≥0.996) replicate everywhere, and projection-monitoring stays strong (Pearson r 0.65–0.99) on every standard model — but collapses to r 0.25–0.48 on the reasoning-distilled DeepSeek-R1.

figures.caption: Over-time arc of the three persona-vector mechanisms across the 2023→2025 era ladder (paper-exact judge). Steering effect and separability AUC hold on every model; monitoring r dips sharply only on the reasoning-distilled DeepSeek-R1. Qwen2.5-7B (diamond) is reused verbatim from the replication.
figures.alt: Three line panels vs model release date: Panel A steering effect ~70-100 with a DeepSeek dip; Panel B Pearson r near 0.7-1.0 for all models except DeepSeek which drops to 0.25-0.48; Panel C AUC flat near 1.0 for all.

figures.caption: Steering dose-response at each model's selected layer (C1): trait score rises monotonically with the steering coefficient for all five models; DeepSeek-R1 has the flattest, lowest curves.
figures.alt: Three panels (evil, sycophantic, hallucinating), each plotting trait score 0-100 versus steering coefficient 0.5-2.5 for five models, all monotonically increasing.

notes: Same instrument for old and new: paper-exact gpt-4.1-mini (OpenRouter, max_tokens=1, T=0, seed=0, logprobs top-20, numeric-mass expectation); 0 judge errors; new-judge spend ~$9-10 under the $40 cap.

Reasoning-model caveat: DeepSeek-R1-Distill's <think> traces break last-prompt projection monitoring (C2) and inflate its baseline hallucination score (72.2); the persona-vector direction still steers behaviour and separates training samples.
Finetune-dependent claims (C3/C4/C10/C11/C12/C15) were NOT re-run on new models (24-LoRA suite ~9 GPU-h/model); the paper-exact Qwen2.5-7B values remain the single anchor. C6/C7/C14 out of scope.

Qwen2.5-7B is reused verbatim from the replication artifacts (values match the 001 spec exactly); the 4 other models were computed fresh this session. All 3 traits were active on all 5 models (no data holes). Qwen3 finished in ~1h36m, inside the 2h budget guard (no descope).
